title: National Partnership Emails — 2020
notes: Kessler explicitly urges members to contest presbytery committee nominations and stresses the need for the NP majority to show up at GA.
The archive praises the PCA Human Sexuality Ad Interim Committee report while noting many NP participants had not supported the Nashville Statement action.
Kessler explicitly states that Beautiful Orthodoxy was not an NP conference but was created from relationships and common cause built through the NP.
The archive describes private NP spreadsheets for presbytery nomination processes and continued committee-placement coordination.
